The programme is tracking to plan, and the remaining work is mostly documentation and sign-off rather than engineering effort. Nothing in this thread changes the delivery schedule for the quarter; the account team will circulate the final deck on Monday and the legal review continues in parallel.

A short note on sequencing: the staging environment will be rebuilt once the maintenance window opens, and the rollback plan has already been reviewed by the on-call group. Please keep the change calendar up to date so that nobody schedules a conflicting release during the same evening.

Finance has asked for a cleaner breakdown of the recurring costs before the next steering meeting. The current spreadsheet mixes one-off onboarding work with the monthly support retainer, which makes the year-on-year comparison harder to read than it needs to be.

On the operational side, the monitoring dashboards are now alerting into the shared channel and the noisy checks have been muted. The remaining gap is a runbook for the failover drill, which the platform group is drafting and expects to circulate later this week.

Procurement would like the renewal paperwork returned before the end of the month, even if a few commercial points remain open. The proposal is to sign the schedule and capture the open items in the statement of work so that the terms are not held up by a single clause.

Support volumes have been stable since the last release, and the queue is clearing within the agreed response times. The team is using the quieter period to tidy the knowledge base and to close out the older tickets that were waiting on customer confirmation.

The security review raised no blocking findings. Two low-risk observations around logging retention are being handled as routine follow-up work, and the owners have committed to landing the changes before the audit window begins.

A reminder that the monthly status note is due at the end of the week. Please send a short summary of progress, risks and decisions needed rather than a full report; the steering group reads the detail separately and only needs the headlines for the discussion.

Travel for the planning session is being arranged centrally, so please avoid booking anything directly. Once the venue is confirmed, the organiser will share the agenda and the joining details for anyone attending remotely.

The vendor has proposed a slightly later cut-over to avoid the peak trading period. That seems sensible from an operational standpoint, and the only open question is whether the revised date still leaves enough room for the acceptance testing before the quarter closes.

Training for the new workflow will run in two short sessions next week, with a recording available afterwards. Attendance is recommended for anyone who approves requests, since the approval steps and the associated notifications are changing.

Finally, the shared mailbox will be monitored by the wider team while the usual owner is away. If something urgent comes in, please escalate through the normal channel rather than waiting for a reply from the individual contact.
